author: @carol
text: Who owns the customer self-serve portal redesign? We need to finalize the mockups by Friday.

author: @frank
text: I am leading that under PRJ_PORTAL_REDESIGN! I have mockups ready in Figma for review.

author: @carol
text: Awesome Frank. Also, Bob: are we sticking to PostgreSQL for the Stripe billing reconciliation ledger?

author: @bob
text: Yes, PostgreSQL with JSONB columns for webhook payloads is the ratified architecture for now.

author: Carol Danvers
text: Published DOC_PORTAL_PRD for customer account settings. Key requirement is self-serve PDF invoice download.

author: cdanvers
text: Our customer support team spends 15 hours a week manually emailing receipts. This feature is top priority for Q1.

author: Carol Danvers
text: Created TICK-402 for PDF invoice download. Frank Wright please review frontend component estimates.

author: @frank
text: Looks straightforward Carol. We can use a client-side React PDF renderer with presigned S3 URLs.

author: @carol
text: Reviewed portal design system with UX research. Customers prefer a unified dark mode layout.

author: Carol Danvers
text: Sprint 14 portal milestone reached: all user wireframes approved by product council.

author: @carol
text: Heads up team: as PRJ_PORTAL_REDESIGN transitions from spec definition into full React development, I will be transitioning project ownership to Frank Wright.

author: Carol Danvers
text: Formal announcement: Effective today March 15, Frank Wright (@frank) is the official owner and project lead for Customer Self-Serve Portal (PRJ_PORTAL_REDESIGN). Documented in DOC_PORTAL_HANDOFF_MEMO.

author: fwright
text: Excited to take the baton from Carol! Thanks for setting such a clear PRD foundation. I am officially project owner now.

author: Frank Wright
text: Created TICK-401 for implementing Tailwind CSS design tokens. Frank Wright is leading implementation.

author: @frank
text: PDF invoice generation component is code-complete and up for review in TICK-402.

author: Aarav Mehta
text: Started QA regression test suite for customer portal redesign on TICK-403.

author: fwright
text: Portal staging environment is updated with Tailwind dark theme. Please take a look and share feedback.

author: @carol
text: Looks stunning Frank! The invoice download is lightning fast.

author: Frank Wright
text: Finalizing beta rollout schedule with marketing for PRJ_PORTAL_REDESIGN.

author: @frank
text: Beta flag will be enabled for 50 select enterprise tenants on Monday.
